title: Retain rejected restart recovery through the synchronous Stop successor path
outcome: When an internal synchronous Stop uses dispatch_queued_prompts_on_success=true and pause_automatic_resumes_on_success=false, a restart recovery selected as successor survives a provably unsent runtime rejection with its durable marker remapped; accepted or ambiguous sends are not replayed. Current production callers leave this drain option disabled.
acceptance: The synchronous Stop successor retains the selected QueuedPromptRecord and uses the shared recovery-aware delivery/requeue owner; no paused Stop or accepted/ambiguous-delivery behavior is changed.

An observable synchronous-rejection regression through the actual Stop successor path persists and reboots, proving the original recovery remains available exactly once with its marker pointing to the retained replacement.
